messages:
Aria: Quick sync — proposing a 6-week "QuickSlice" pilot to validate a lightweight onboard flow that covers: benching, temporary pin windows, and a fast rollback path. Goal: reduce friction for customer-driven pins while protecting stability.
Devon: +1. Can you clarify infra assumptions? GPU pools, burst capacity, and whether this uses an isolated canary shard?
Aria: Plan is to use an isolated canary pool in Dedicated (small reserved) so we can hit perf SLAs without touching prod pools. Burst to hosted if needed.
Ravi: For benchmarks we should run both throughput microbench (tokens/sec at p50/p95) and quality evals (hallucination rate & regression harness). My baseline: embed recall >= 0.88, gen perplexity delta <= 5%.
Sara: From customers: many ask for pin windows of 30d. Sales pushback on anything shorter. They also want a comms SLA if we plan deprecations.
Aria: We should negotiate: pilot offers a default 14d pin with auto-extension gates (metrics & business ok) — acceptable compromise?
Devon: Implementation notes: need an ops toggle for auto-extend + audit log. Also ensure KV-cache warmup path is isolated so canary perf isn't dominated by cold caches.
Ravi: Suggest automatic bench harness that runs nightly on canary: inputs -> metric snapshot -> regression alerts. If delta > threshold, auto-block extension.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pool provisioned (pool-id: canary-qs-01). Provision time 03:12 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Sara: Customers will accept shorter pins if we offer clear rollback + migration credits. Can we add a line to the customer SOW template?
Aria: Yes — updated comms template draft: "Pilot pin: 14d default; auto-extension requires passing nightly regressions for 7 consecutive days; opt-in for 30d with business case."
Devon: Need a small config snippet for ops. Example: 
```
pin_window_days: 14
auto_extension_enabled: true
extend_criteria: ["nightly_regressions_passed_7d", "no_sev_1_incidents_14d"]
```
Ravi: Eval thresholds proposal (to put in acceptance tests): 
- embedding_recall >= 0.88
- gen_perplexity_delta <= 5%
- p95_latency <= 1.5x baseline
- failure_rate <= 0.5%
Aria: Launch criteria (concise): 1) Bench harness green for 7 days, 2) SRE runbook + rollback tested, 3) Sales SOW updated & legal ok, 4) 2 pilot customers signed up.
Sara: I'll pull two customers that want slow migration and would accept a pilot (enterprise accounts). I can present migration credits as incentive.
Devon: Ops checklist: create canary pool, add audit logs to Console, expose pin_window config in UI, smoke test routing/fallback.
Ravi: Also add a quick regression dataset (500 prompts) that runs in CI and can be replayed on-demand.
Aria: Action items: 
- Aria: finalize comms + SOW draft by Fri.
- Ravi: bench harness + regression dataset by next Wed.
- Devon: ops toggle + CI smoke by next Wed.
- Sara: recruit 2 pilot customers by EOD Tue.
Agree to a 30m follow-up Thurs 10:30 PT to sign off on criteria. :calendar:
Devon: Sounds good. I'll add the config PR and link it in the doc.
Sara: Will flag any customer constraints asap.
Aria: Thanks team — will drop the draft doc in #product-docs and ping reviewers.
ops-bot: reminder-bot: Meeting scheduled Thu 10:30 PT.
